evals.prompt: Create an ArcGIS Pro Desktop workflow activity in C# that calculates the convex hull for selected map features using the ArcGIS Pro SDK.
evals.expected_output: A C# activity implementing IActivityHandler with defensive input parsing, async execution inside QueuedTask.Run, and static Action identifier.
expectations: Activity implements IActivityHandler and returns Task<IDictionary<string, object?>>
Uses inputs.TryGetValue defensibly to prevent KeyNotFoundException
Wraps ArcGIS Pro API calls inside await QueuedTask.Run(...)
Defines public static string Action identifier
Catches exceptions and wraps them in descriptive error messages

evals.prompt: Build a custom Mobile form element with XAML and C# for VertiGIS Studio Mobile that renders a rating slider with custom feedback.
evals.expected_output: A XAML ContentComponent with C# code-behind and a companion registration activity extending RegisterCustomFormElementBase.
expectations: Custom element extends ContentComponent from VertiGIS.Mobile.Forms
XAML controls use accessible labels and touch targets suitable for field devices

evals.prompt: Generate the TypeScript designer stub for a .NET activity called CalculateParcelAssessmentActivity with @displayName, @category, and @action tags.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript declaration stub file for the Workflow Designer toolbox with proper JSDoc annotations.
expectations: Includes @action tag matching the C# static Action identifier
Defines dropdown union inputs inline rather than external type aliases
